title: One fact per subject on one editable card
goal: One fact per subject on one editable card
acceptance: A multi-fact request proposes one fact per subject; each editable or removable before approving the card
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
